Antep Fıstıklı Sucuk (Talep Üzerine Her Türlü Meyve Pekmezleri Kullanılır.)

text.en:
Antep Pistachio Sucuk (Molasses-Coated Nut Roll) – All Kinds of Fruit Molasses Can Be Used Upon Request

Tufan Organik Antep Pistachio Sucuk (Molasses-Coated Nut Roll) – All Kinds of Fruit Molasses Can Be Used Upon Request belongs to the Molasses, Tahini and Halva range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.
